newsitem.title: UK: Two new Bank of England directors named.
newsitem.headline: Two new Bank of England directors named.

text.p: The Bank of England said Andrew Buxton, chairman of Barclays Plc, and Alastair Clark, a deputy director of the Bank responsible for Financial Structure, had been appointed directors with effect from March 1.
They will replace Sir Jeremy Morse and Pen Kent, who are retiring.
Frances Heaton and Sir Chips Keswick have been reappointed for further four-year terms.
John Footman, secretary of the Bank and its chief press officer, will succeed Clark as deputy director in the Financial Structure area.
Peter Rodgers, financial editor of the Independent newspaper, has been appointed secretary and will take over Footman's responsibilities for press affairs.
